# function: median

Return the median average of the number elements of an input list parameter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Return the median average of the element(s) of an even length list:
provider::stdlib::median([1.2, 5.4, 3.1, 8.9])
# result => 4.25

# Return the median average of the element(s) of an odd length list:
provider::stdlib::median([7, 2, 5])
# result => 5.0
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
median(list list of number) number
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `list` (List of Number) Input list parameter for determining the median.
